title: TRAINING UNBIASED DIFFUSION MODELS FROM BIASED DATASET
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on mitigating latent biases such as class imbalance, gender, and hair color in image datasets.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it does not analyze this aspect.
